subject: Tideway SIG follow-up: ephemeral CI runners, signed commits & change-window logs
messages:
From: Lara Nazer <lara@auditlab.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mchen@tideway.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tideway assessment - follow ups on CI/CD artifacts

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we close out the SIG/SOC2-lite evidence pack for Tideway, the assessor asked for a few specific items we couldn't pull live during the demo: 

1) Ephemeral CI runner configuration and lifecycle controls (how runners are provisioned, how long they live, who can request them).
2) A PR audit extract showing reviewer approvals and timestamps for the last 90 days (prefer CSV).
3) Summary of commit signing policy + a short sample of signed commits.
4) Change-window approvals/log with justification for any emergency out-of-window deploys in the last 12 months.

If possible, we'd like these as attachments (redacted where necessary) plus a short narrative for each artifact describing where it was pulled from and any retention/rotation policies. Target turnaround: end of week (Fri 23 Jun). Can you confirm?

Best,
Lara

Lara Nazer
Senior Assessor, AuditLab
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Lara Nazer <lara@auditlab.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mchen@tideway.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tideway assessment - follow ups on CI/CD artifacts

Hi Lara —

We can provide all four artifacts. Quick plan below: 

- Ephemeral runners: will attach the runner config (ci-runner-config.yaml) plus a short note on the lifecycle (provision, TTL, and automated cleanup). Runners are ephemeral by default; we enforce 10m min/1h max TTL via orchestration policy; privileged runners require step-up approval.
- PR audit: export (pr-audit-export-20280621.csv) with reviewer + approval timestamps pulled from our internal PR audit service. We will redact internal ticket IDs per our disclosure policy.
- Commit signing: signed-commits-summary.txt — overview of commit-signing enforcement, where signatures are verified (pre-merge), and a few representative commit SHA+signature lines (no private keys).
- Change-window: change-window-approvals.log — includes scheduled windows, approver emails, and a note for the one emergency out-of-window deploy (root cause + mitigation).

Irene (cc) will confirm the exports and add the narrative blurb for each artifact. Marissa, copying you for awareness on the retention footnote — please confirm retention period for PR exports.

I'll attach an evidence checklist (evidence-checklist-Tideway.pdf) that ties each file back to the SIG/CAT question IDs. We will deliver redacted attachments and a Drive link (see HubSpot link in thread) by EOD Fri.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: artifact pull + redaction checklist (Tideway)

Team —

Lara needs the four artifacts below by EOD Fri 23 Jun. Can you confirm ownership and any blockers: 

1) Ephemeral runner config + lifecycle note (ci-runner-config.yaml) — Jordan, can you export the current runner template and include the policy that enforces TTL + revocation hooks? Also include the control that prevents persistent mounting of instance storage.

2) PR audit CSV (pr-audit-export-20280621.csv) — Irene, please run the PR export for the Tideway org for the last 90 days. Redact internal ticket subject lines and any PII. Include column headers in the CSV: pr_id, author, reviewer, approval_ts, merged_ts, files_changed.

3) Commit signing summary (signed-commits-summary.txt) — Jordan/Irene, produce a short narrative of the enforcement point (server-side pre-merge hook validating sigs) and include 3 example SHAs with signature verification output (no private material).

4) Change-window log (change-window-approvals.log) — Marissa, pull the approval entries from the change-management system. For the emergency window on 2027-11-17 include the approver, justification summary (max 2 lines), and rollback notes.

Redaction rules: remove internal ticket metadata and any user emails other than approvers. Mark redacted fields as [REDACTED].

If anything here is going to miss the deadline, flag now and we'll push the assessor deadline to Mon 26 Jun.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sofia
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Lara Nazer <lara@auditlab.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 14:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tideway assessment - artifacts attached

Hi all — attaching the exports per Sofia's plan. Attachments: ci-runner-config.yaml, pr-audit-export-20280621.csv, signed-commits-summary.txt, change-window-approvals.log, evidence-checklist-Tideway.pdf

Notes on each artifact (short):

- ci-runner-config.yaml: shows the ephemeral runner bootstrap script, TTL enforcement (3600s max), metadata tagging with owner_team, and the automated revoke hook tied to the runner-provisioning service. Secrets used by runners are injected via short-lived vault tokens; tokens expire within 60s after runner termination.

- pr-audit-export-20280621.csv: includes PR approvals and timestamps; ticket titles removed per redaction policy. Retention policy: audit exports retained for 18 months in the audit ledger (Marissa confirmed).

- signed-commits-summary.txt: describes our git commit-signing requirement; server-side verification occurs in the merge pipeline and requires a valid GPG/SSH signature. Sample verification output lines included for three SHAs.

- change-window-approvals.log: lists scheduled windows and approvals. The emergency deploy 2027-11-17 was approved by ops-lead@tideway.com (marked with justification: security hotfix to CVE-2027-4521); rollback executed within 45 minutes, postmortem linked in Drive.

If the assessor needs raw logs (longer CSV or full change history) we prefer a scoped scan request — we can provide under NDA/secure share. Otherwise this package should satisfy the SIG/CAT questions Lara referenced.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Security Lead — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
